sources.title: SylphAI-Inc/AdalFlow | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: AdalFlow is a PyTorch-inspired library for building and auto-optimizing Large Language Model (LLM) applications. The library provides a unified framework for constructing task pipelines—ranging from chatbots and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems to agentic workflows—and automatically optimizing their prompts and few-shot examples ...
